sloka: अहं तु तैः संयति चण्डविक्रमैः समेत्य रक्षोभिरसह्यविक्रमः ।निहत्य तद्रावणचोदितं बलं सुखं गमिष्यामि कपीश्वरालयम् ।। ५.४१.१३।।।।
transliteration: ahaṁ tu taiḥ saṁyati caṇḍavikramaiḥ sametya rakṣobhirasahyavikramaḥ ।nihatya tadrāvaṇacoditaṁ balaṁ sukhaṁ gamiṣyāmi kapīśvarālayam ।। 5.41.13।।।।

translations.english: 'I will fight with the ogres sent by Ravana, endowed with fierce strength and irresistible valour. After destroying their army I will go to the abode of vanaras happily'.
